issues.text: Unlisted claim: two general statements about all unit tests (speed in milliseconds; same result on every run while code is unchanged) are not in the claims ledger. They are supportable (unit-testing-best-practices.md: "Unit tests should take little time to run. Milliseconds." / "Repeatable: ... The test always returns the same result if you don't change anything in between runs.") but must be listed.
issues.quote: A unit test runs only the piece it is about, finishes in milliseconds, and gives the same answer every time the code has not changed.
issues.fix: Add a claim to .meta.json (kind behavior, section 4, source_hint refs/dotnet-docs/docs/core/testing/unit-testing-best-practices.md 'Characteristics of good unit tests': Fast, Repeatable). Optionally soften to "usually finishes in milliseconds" to match the docs' "should".

issues.text: Arrange-act-assert is presented as the defining structure of every unit test and is not in the ledger. The .NET docs call it "a common approach for writing unit tests", not a requirement; the lesson's own code merges act and assert on one line.
issues.quote: arrange, act, assert — the three steps of a unit test, in this order
issues.fix: Rephrase to "arrange, act, assert — the common pattern for the three steps of a unit test, in this order: ..." and add a claim citing refs/dotnet-docs/docs/core/testing/unit-testing-best-practices.md 'Arrange your tests'.

issues.text: The lesson depends on xUnit behaviour (`[Fact]`, the Assert.Equal failure text "Expected: 0 / Actual: 30000") but front matter lists only `dotnet`. The failure-message format is xUnit-version-specific; `testing.xunit` (2.9.2) exists in versions.yaml.
issues.fix: Change front matter to `versions_used: [dotnet, xunit]` so a future xUnit bump triggers re-review of this lesson.

issues.quote: A test that reads from PostgreSQL may finish in under a second, but it now fails if the database is down or holds different rows.
issues.text: PostgreSQL is not in my vocab and not defined. I can guess from 'the database' later in the sentence that it is some database, but I have to guess; quiz q2 repeats it.
issues.fix: Replace 'reads from PostgreSQL' with 'reads from the database' (and the same in quiz q2), or add 'the PostgreSQL database' so the name is explained where it first appears.

issues.quote: You notice the difference when a later change breaks the rule and nobody rereads that line, but the test goes red.
issues.text: 'goes red' is jargon I have not seen; nothing in the lesson says a failing test is shown in red. I assume it means 'fails' but have to guess.
issues.fix: Replace 'but the test goes red' with 'but the test fails'.

issues.quote: B --> C[assert: compare with the rule] ... C -->|different| F[test fails, report names it]

issues.fix: Add one sentence after 'the comparison is the judgement': 'If the values are equal the test passes; if not, it fails and the report names the test that failed.' and say in the same paragraph that ForOrder is StandardShipping's method that returns the fee for an order total.
